01_protected_start.note: Wall fixtures sit on their walls: world_decor centred a fixture at 64 - B/2, legacy's horizon (48 + 16) fixed in, so on the slim horizon (60) every sign drew 12 px high and a distant one rose off its wall into the ceiling. It now uses HORIZON + 16; only fixture pixels move (12 px down), legacy is byte-identical.

06_mess_open.note: Sable Outpost (sector 1) is redrawn as a named place: the landing airlock, a U-shaped decon passage, the bunk room and mess hall off it, and the comms room where the Sentinel guards the lift, which stands in a machinery frame. The spawn, the airlock door ahead of it, the Sentinel, the exit door and the lift keep their cells, so every pose names the same place; the zig-zag door became the mess hatch (tour captures renamed). Only the world view changes, apart from the helmet blink landing on other captures because update timing moved; every frame check passes.
